sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana is a scheme by the Bihar government aimed at promoting girl child education, curbing child marriages, reducing fertility rates, and empowering girls to become self-reliant.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Scholarships and student finance

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana&quot;, a component of the &quot;Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana&quot;, launched by the Education Department, Bihar, focuses on the socio-economic upliftment of girls in Bihar. The scheme provides monetary incentives to unmarried girls who have cleared their intermediate examinations from recognized schools or madrasas within Bihar.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Financial Assistance:** ₹10,000/- for girls passing intermediate in 2021; ₹25,000/- in 2022 and later. <br>

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the Registration [page](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/Default.aspx). **Step 2:** Scroll down below and click on "Students Click Here To Apply". **Step 3:** Read the instructions and click on the check-boxes. Click on "Continue". **Step 4:** Enter all the mandatory details and create a new password. Validate the Captcha code. **Step 5:** Click on “Submit” to generate the login ID and Password. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the Login [page](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/Login.aspx). **Step 2:** Enter all the mandatory details and upload all the required documents. **Step 3:** Recheck all entries before final submission, no modifications can be made in the application after final submission. **Step 4:** Click on “Submit” and take a printout of a copy of the submitted application. > **Check application Details:** Click [Here](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/StudentStatus.aspx). > **Payment Done Information:** Click [Here](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/PaymentDoneList.aspx).  > ***Helpdesk:*** For technical problems: Click [Here](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/Helpdesk.aspx).
